propositions: T5c security review currently evaluates plans as written per shared preamble, not grounded in current codebase/config, causing 46% of strong findings to cite repo artifacts despite ungrounded stance.
T5c generates duplicate advisory findings for plans with N undeclared access surfaces (one finding per surface), consuming advisory cap and displacing other criteria in 103+ reviews.
Candidate findings lacking both read repo artifacts and quoted plan sentences are pressed at the same severity as grounded findings, preventing Pass-2 deduplication and inflating advisory count.

T5c must shift to grounded evaluation (controls defined in codebase flip findings), emit at most one undeclared-access-posture finding per plan, demote ungrounded findings to MINOR, and restrict HIGH severity to two classes (plaintext secrets on boundary paths and undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surfaces).
T5c routing entry must change from advisory @ 0.95 to blocking @ 0.9 to enforce the tightened severity scoping via existing pass3_decide machinery.

All rubric changes are criterion-local overrides within plan_review_T5c.md (not in passes.py or prompts.py per ticket 9374) and follow the T10 bfa8 pattern of rubric-text severity guidance without new orchestrator machinery.
